description: ARP-based network scanner with terminal UI, web dashboard, and nginx reverse-proxy for Luckfox IoT devices.

skills.name: build
skills.description: Compile the scanner natively (x86_64) or cross-compile for Raspberry Pi (ARM).

skills.name: deploy-pi
skills.description: Upload the binary to the Pi via SCP and launch the full nginx proxy stack.

skills.name: web-ui
skills.description: Edit the browser dashboard (scanner.html), embed it into the binary, and extend HTTP routes.

skills.name: comments
skills.description: Manage persistent host labels in ~/.ipscanner.comments by IP or MAC address.

skills.name: probe
skills.description: Add or tune active probing methods (SSH banner, HTTP, mDNS) used for vendor identification.

skills.name: arp-scan
skills.description: Understand and extend the raw ARP scanner, parallel resolver, and OUI lookup engine.

skills.name: nginx-proxy
skills.description: Generate and manage nginx reverse-proxy configs that expose Luckfox device UIs remotely.
